description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber' that acts as an event subscriber within a Symfony-based application. Its purpose is to monitor incoming HTTP requests and throw exceptions if the request targets disabled modules, thereby preventing access or forwarding appropriately.

classes.name: ModuleNotAvailableSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber for handling HTTP requests, checking if the modules in the request path are disabled, and raising appropriate exceptions to restrict access.

methods.name: getModuleService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of ModuleService used to fetch module data.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the Symfony kernel request event to the handler method and its priority.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the incoming request event by checking if the targeted module is disabled and throwing exceptions to prevent access or redirect as needed.
